finding.before: readDwgClassesTail rejected the bounded section before its documented warn-only sentinel policy; dwgR reported BAD_READ_CLASSES (legacyError 8).
finding.after: The helper reports an incomplete sentinel as a warning, leaves the cursor bounded, and the reader publishes the decoded class records. The same input now proceeds past CLASSES and reports BAD_READ_TABLES (legacyError 9).
finding.classes_crc: The parser reports a CRC mismatch as a warning (stored 0x5e72, calculated 0x2d07); this change does not explain or waive that discrepancy.

implementation.behavior: The shared R2004/R2007+ CLASSES-tail helper distinguishes a complete matching sentinel from a missing, incomplete, or nonmatching tail. Callers only read the sentinel when the complete sentinel was found; missing tails stay warning-only without poisoning the buffer cursor.

validation.build: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_class_source_tests -j4 passed; library and test adapter compiled with project warning flags.
validation.focused_tail_control: CTest libdxfrw_dwg_class_source_tail passed (1/1, 0.01 seconds) for 0/1/2/8-byte trailer forms, full sentinel forms, truncated sentinel lengths 0..15, and malformed bounded tails.
validation.source_import: A temporary import probe using the rebuilt test adapter read this exact external sample through CLASSES and returned BAD_READ_TABLES (legacyError 9), confirming the prior BAD_READ_CLASSES failure is removed. The one-off probe entry point was not retained in the repository.
validation.broader_ctest: libdxfrw_dwg_class_source failed later in its existing native AC1015 comparison at line 457 (both adapters report a failed AC1015 import); the focused tail control passed.
validation.dwg2dxf_link: The dwg2dxf relink was blocked by Apple SDK CoreFoundation nullability-extension diagnostics promoted to errors in dwg2dxf/dx_batch_output_names.cpp; no warning suppression was added.

libdxfrw.result: The AC1024 bounded separated-tail profile does not match; the control remains refused.

later_ltype_control_failure.decision: Keep the strict LTYPE_CONTROL refusal. The source has unknown producer provenance and an unexplained CLASSES CRC mismatch; the peer result is insufficient evidence for parser relaxation or a support claim.

limits: This is one hash-specific AC1024 reproduction, not proof of the reported six-of-ten AutoCAD 2010 RTM behavior.
The sample still fails later at TABLES; it is not a full DWG read success.
The CLASSES CRC mismatch remains unexplained and visible as a warning.
No format support or output claim is promoted.
